result.topic_en: Gauss tabulates grid values of A−C, B−D and A−B+C−D, studies sums of squared Gaussian-integer quantities of the form $[2fM/m]$ for very large M, and derives formulas for a quantity Ω (the difference m/M − M/m) depending on the parities of a, b, A, B, in connection with biquadratic reciprocity.

methods.what: Grid tables of differences of counts A−C, B−D and the combination A−B+C−D
Empirical asymptotic value of a normalized sum of squared bracket (floor-type) Gaussian-integer expressions for large M
Table of values of Σff/m for various Gaussian integers m
Expression for m/M − M/m in terms of the components a, b, A, B, defined as Ω
Case formulas for Ω according to which components a, b, A, B are odd
Attempt at a single general formula for Ω covering all parity cases

items.quote: Eine fruchtbare Idee scheint die zu seyn, zu untersuchen wie sich die Relationen ändern, wenn m um 2M zunimmt. Dabei wird man sich aber wol am besten an die Darstellung halten wo alle Grenzlinien auf einander senkrecht werden
items.english: A fruitful idea seems to be to investigate how the relations change when m increases by 2M. In doing so, one would probably do best to keep to the representation in which all boundary lines become mutually perpendicular.
